scope: Production web deployment of verified observatory, diagnostics, table controls, camera scope and VirtualSky corrections

backup.details: Protected deployment record on device; private backup contents and logs are not included

acceptance.evidence: New image records for cameras 1 and 2; corresponding files present and nonempty.
Authenticated browser loaded both camera images and Running capture summary.
Switch to second profile selected its link and changed displayed saved readings; does not validate physical calibration.
Selected profile, decoded frame and rendered canvas agreed for both cameras; current frame status updated.
Enter and Exit fullscreen succeeded; focus returned to Fullscreen and page controls returned.

limits: This is bounded release acceptance, not the exhaustive per-control matrix
Remaining production actions, roles, narrow-screen checks and integrations remain open
Anomalous stored SQM values require a separate calibration/labeling review; no scientific algorithm changed
Rollback code path prepared but not drilled against the installed release
24-hour monitoring deferred to a separate activity after Classic removal
